name: 1.3 inch Crawler Tyres
desc: These crawler tires are designed to fit 1.3 inch wheels. They are used to enhance the off-road performance of small-scale RC vehicles.

name: GRC Racing 1.9inch Wheels
desc: These wheels are designed for RC racing applications and provide a mounting surface for tyres. They are used to replace damaged wheels or to change the look and performance of the vehicle.

name: Winch Controller
desc: An electronic controller used to operate an RC winch from the vehicle's radio system. It regulates the power and direction of the winch motor.

name: 1.9 inch Crawler Tyres (Set)
desc: This is a complete set of 1.9 inch tires for 1/10 scale off-road vehicles. They are used to provide traction and durability during trail driving.

name: PTK 1/18 High Torque Servo
desc: A steering servo with increased torque output designed for 1/18 scale RC vehicles. It provides stronger steering force for better control in demanding conditions.

name: 40kg High Torque Servo
fits: 1/10 and 1/8 scale RC cars, trucks, and crawlers
desc: This is a high-torque digital servo capable of providing up to 40kg of pulling power. It is used for steering or other high-load applications in larger RC models.

name: Rlaarlo MK07 V2 Brushless ESC
desc: An electronic speed controller designed for the brushless version of the Rlaarlo MK07. It regulates the power delivered from the battery to the motor.

name: Electric Screwdriver
desc: This tool is an electric screwdriver bundled with various hex bits specifically for RC maintenance. It helps speed up the assembly and disassembly of vehicle components.

name: 1/10 Scale Buckle Straps (5 pcs)
desc: These adjustable buckle straps are used to secure batteries or scale accessories to a 1/10 scale vehicle. The pack contains five individual straps.

name: D1RC 100mm Shocks
desc: These 100mm shock absorbers from D1RC are used to provide suspension travel and damping for larger RC models. They are suitable for custom builds or as upgrades for compatible chassis.

name: 1/10 Roof Luggage Net
desc: An elastic net used to secure scale accessories on the roof rack of a 1/10 scale vehicle. It helps keep decorative items in place during off-road driving.

name: 1/10 Roof Light Bar
desc: An LED light bar designed to be mounted on the roof of a 1/10 scale RC vehicle. It provides additional illumination for night driving and enhances the scale appearance.

name: 1/10 Maintenance Stand
desc: A rotating stand designed to hold 1/10 scale RC vehicles during repair or maintenance. It provides a stable platform to work on the chassis and suspension components.

name: 1.9 inch Silicone Tyre Inserts
desc: These silicone inserts replace standard foam inside 1.9 inch tires. They provide consistent support and help the tire maintain its shape under load.

name: 1.0 inch Crawler Tyres
desc: These 1.0 inch tires are intended for micro crawler wheels. They are used to replace stock tires for better traction during rock crawling.

name: Injora 1.0 inch Crawler Tyres
desc: These 1.0 inch tires from Injora are designed for small-scale rock crawlers. They provide improved grip on various off-road surfaces.

name: HobbyPark 9kg Waterproof Digital Mini Servo with Stainless Steel Gears
fits: Traxxas TRX-4M, TRX-4MT, 1/18 crawlers, FCX18, FCX24, H18P
desc: This digital mini servo is a high-torque upgrade for small-scale RC crawlers like the TRX-4M. It features stainless steel gears for increased durability and is waterproof for reliable performance in wet conditions. The unit provides 9kg of stall torque to improve steering precision on difficult terrain.
